scope: Recorded EPUB local start-error propagation and native ownership lifetime only

tests.added_case_arithmetic: 2 admission/device x 2 direct/deferred + 8 revoked request states + original-error/repeated-notification + real quiet timeout = 14

checks: Every byte outside EbookAudioDialog.play is identical; transport/player/stop/cleanup implementations remain unchanged.
All 14 original case bodies and decorators are retained as an exact test prefix; four appended functions provide 14 new cases.
Read actual OverlayPlayback.start/stop: failed start closes its owned player/prepared result and advances the ticket generation before rethrowing.
Read actual play_when_quiet: its later alive check rejects that advanced ticket, establishing the local missing-notification path without diagnosing physical device availability.

Local failed callback retains the original object, permits only the captured owner/session/selection and zero or one own cleanup generation, refuses cancellation/closed/replaced/interrupted requests, and reports at most once.
Notification failure is caught only around presentation, preserving the original failure and bounded diagnostic note; existing cleanup retains native ownership.

Regressions use the actual borrowed serial executor, OverlayPlayback, and shared quiet helper; native player/widgets are explicit doubles. Direct/deferred failure, revoked state, quiet hold disposal, old/new owner separation, and same-object propagation are observed.
not_claimed: No physical device cause inferred from previous preparing/idle/null-error observation.
No shared helper, player, timeout, native25 inventory or approval boundary relaxed.
